title: when the cameras are constantly rolling…

segments.text: tell me about your experience of making the documentary so we spent about 1 year straight of filming it was really intense um it was about a couple days a week Chris would just show up and start filming and we really didn't have any kind of input or say on how he was going to use the footage and they're rolling all the time so it's been yeah over a year since we've stopped filming and I still have this feeling of like I need to run an algorithm of am I on record right now like it's just constant feeling like it's a mic on you and so it was really like for someone who's never on camera who's not comfortable being on camera it was a really big change for me
to go from not having to worry about that to like every single day where conscious planning for or filming
